messages:
maria_finance: Heads up — nightly reconcile job (billing-reconciler) created 12 credit memos in NetSuite for 2025-03-10 invoices but Stripe shows no credits. Seeing mismatched totals on the MTD report: https://redwood.internal/billing/recon/1759
lexi_eng: ugh. I pulled the webhook delivery logs — looks like invoice.updated was delivered twice for the same event id  ev_3Jq8Xx. Stripe acked both. Might be our retry handler requeueing instead of deduping :facepalm:
jonathan_billing: NetSuite import is throwing "Invalid debit/credit balance" for the credit memos. I think the reconciler constructs a JE with negative line items and Netsuite expects opposite sign on the header. We get duplicate updates -> duplicate memos -> imbalance.
ops-bot: deploy: billing-reconciler v2.4.1 deployed by ci-bot at 2025-11-28T02:10Z :rocket:
lexi_eng: logs snippet (from the reconciler) showing the double delivery and payload id: 
```
2025-11-28T02:09:14Z INFO reconcile: handling stripe_event ev_3Jq8Xx invoice.updated
2025-11-28T02:09:14Z INFO reconcile: create netSuitePayload {"invoice_id":"in_1Jq4...","lines":[{"amount":-1200,...}],"memo":"credit"}
2025-11-28T02:09:15Z WARN reconcile: duplicate event id ev_3Jq8Xx seen, retry_count=1
2025-11-28T02:09:15Z INFO reconcile: handling stripe_event ev_3Jq8Xx invoice.updated
```
paul_support: temporary mitigation — can we pause the nightly import into NetSuite while we patch? I can run a manual dedupe and void the duplicate memos if you want me to. SQL to find dupes: `SELECT invoice_id, COUNT(*) FROM net_suite_memos WHERE source_event_id = 'ev_3Jq8Xx' GROUP BY invoice_id HAVING COUNT(*)>1;`
maria_finance: Please pause imports now, @paul_support go ahead with manual dedupe for the 12 affected invoices. @lexi_eng can you open a PR for idempotency check (store processed stripe_event ids) and add a quick fix to webhook retry handling? I'll file a jira for a postmortem and impact to revenue recognition. :thumbsup:
lexi_eng: on it, will add event dedupe table + backfill script. ETA for hotfix is ~2h.
maria_finance: thanks everyone — keep updates in this thread and ping me when done.
